The worst in->reg path (+7.88) scales as 0.8T and the worst r2r path (+8.974) as T. Rescaled to R1=13.8: r2r +1.52, in->reg +1.92, in->out +3.0. Hold WS +0.107 is r2r at min_ff, period-independent, repaired to about 0.1 by 1328 hold buffers. DRV is 992, from about 113 fanout-10 nets slewing only at ss, against a bar of 2881. Route DRC is 0 at 47% utilisation. The next rung, R2 of about 12.30, sits near zero max_ss slack, and the resizer sees optimistic nominal-RC/GRT estimates, so it is about 50/50.
